name: مدار
subtitle: للصلاة والقرآن ويومك
promotionalText: مساحة عربية تجمع الصلاة والقرآن والمذكرات والعادات والمال والقراءة، مع حفظ محلي وخيار لمزامنة iCloud.
description:
مدار مساحة ليومك، من أول صلاة إلى آخر سطر.

الصلاة: أوقات الصلاة، والتسجيل والتراجع، والقضاء والسفر.
القرآن: خطة للحفظ والمراجعة، ومتابعة جلساتك وموضعك.
المذكرات: أيامك وخواطرك وصورك وتسجيلاتك، مع البحث والتصدير.
العادات: متابعة ما تكرره، وقراءة تقدّمك من سجلاتك الفعلية.
المال: حساباتك ومصاريفك ومظاريفك والتزاماتك، وحساب تقريبي للزكاة وفق الخيارات التي تحددها. أسعار الصرف والمعادن تدخلها يدويًا.
المحبرة: مكتبتك الورقية والرقمية، وقارئ EPUB وPDF، وبحث محلي في النص والصور باستخدام التعرّف الضوئي.

واجهة عربية من اليمين إلى اليسار، وتواريخ هجرية وميلادية، وودجات واختصارات للوصول إلى غرفك.

لا تحتاج سجلاتك إلى حساب مدار. تعمل النسخة المحلية بلا مزامنة؛ وفي النسخة المهيأة لـCloudKit تختار تشغيل مزامنة iCloud من إعدادات مدار. عند تشغيلها، تتزامن السجلات المدعومة عبر قاعدة iCloud الخاصة بحسابك، وإيقافها لا يحذف ما سبق رفعه. بعض الخدمات الاختيارية تحتاج إلى الإنترنت، مثل تنزيل الكتب والتحويل الصوتي عبر Apple بعد موافقتك. التعرّف الضوئي قد يخطئ، فتبقى صورة الصفحة مرجعك. حساب الزكاة تقديري ولا يثبت تحقق شروط الوجوب في حالتك.
reviewNotes: No account or backend login is required. The default build is local-only because MADAR_CLOUDKIT_CONTAINER is empty. A signed CloudKit build exposes an opt-in iCloud sync toggle; first enablement writes an encrypted checkpoint before mirroring. Turning the toggle off leaves previously synced records in the user’s private CloudKit database. CloudKit-enabled sync has not been tested on a signed owner device; do not treat the local simulator build as CloudKit evidence. On first launch, choose a city and complete onboarding. Face ID is an optional app-level biometric gate; it has no passcode fallback. Widgets and Controls read app-written snapshots; extensions do not open the SwiftData store. HealthKit is optional and read-only for walking totals. Bank messages arrive only via user-initiated paste or a configured Shortcut; the app does not read the Messages database. Metal prices and exchange rates are manual. The Zakat screen labels results as approximate, asks for the nisab/debt method and shows source links. On-device Vision OCR operates on PDF image pages without modifying the original file; OCR text exists only while its search sheet is open. Downloaded Turath books read locally after import. Optional Apple server speech recognition requires separate in-app consent; on-device routes are preferred. Spotlight is optional, off by default, and indexes book titles only. No advertising, tracking SDK or developer analytics is integrated. iOS 27-only widget families are hidden on iOS 26.

book files and on-device OCR text

appleServerSpeechAfterConsent.note: Do not submit a blanket Data Not Collected response while this optional server route ships. Apple handles its own retention under its speech privacy notice.

privacyLabelPreparation.turathNetwork: Catalogue searches run locally. Download requests expose the requested public book ID and ordinary connection metadata, including IP address, to files.turath.io and its hosting provider. No diary, financial record, book annotation or local search query is uploaded. Provider retention was not established; do not claim anonymous networking or confirmed zero retention.
privacyLabelPreparation.localOnlyDataAppliesTo: This local-only description applies when CloudKit is unavailable or the user has not enabled sync; it does not describe a CloudKit-enabled, opted-in build.
privacyLabelPreparation.developerOperatedCollectionNote: No Madar-operated records backend is integrated. This does not mean CloudKit sync is local-only: the app writes supported user records to Apple CloudKit when the signed build is provisioned and the user enables the toggle.

cloudKitSync.availability: Only a signed build with an entitled MADAR_CLOUDKIT_CONTAINER; the default build remains local-only.
cloudKitSync.userOptIn: The sync setting is off for a newly bound account and the user enables it in SyncSettingsView.
cloudKitSync.firstEnableBehavior: The app requires an encrypted checkpoint before enabling the mirrored store.
cloudKitSync.destination: The signed-in Apple account private CloudKit database; its data counts toward that account’s iCloud storage quota.
dataCategoriesInSyncedModels: Settings and records for prayer, Quran, diary, habits, money, books and reading progress.
User-entered diary and letter text, pasted bank-message text and financial records.
Media model payloads, including user-added photos, audio and imported book data.
Saved trip and place coordinates carried by synced records.
cloudKitSync.appPrivacyLabelStatus: Pending review for the exact release build. Apple defines collection as off-device transmission stored accessibly beyond real-time servicing; assess persistent CloudKit data types and purposes before using any local-only label.

publicationInputsStillRequired: A public HTTPS URL for privacy.html and a real support destination; no address or domain has been invented.
App Store Connect account access, distribution signing and review contact details.
Owner and Claude's full-screen comparison captures and later real-device checks.
Confirm the third-party network retention disclosure against the provider's published policy before submitting the privacy label.
Review App Privacy categories and purposes against the exact CloudKit-enabled release build; do not reuse a local-only answer.
Confirm a user-approved CloudKit copy deletion and retention path; turning sync off currently leaves existing iCloud data and no in-app delete control is implemented.
